status.main_product: Drone-based surveying, mapping, and asset management analytics

The company reports that its software algorithms can automatically detect stockpile boundaries from georeferenced drone data to achieve up to 98% accuracy in volumetric measurements for mining operations.
The company reported in October 2023 that its AEREO INP drone model achieved small category type certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
